subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept first-party math rendering in Control UI chat, and if so should it use an opt-in KaTeX/MathJax configuration surface in core?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a core UI dependency, public config surface, and untrusted-rendering sanitizer behavior that automation should not accept without maintainer product/security direction.

options.title: Review one candidate core implementation
options.body: Pick one open KaTeX/MathJax PR as the landing path and require dependency, sanitizer, config, upgrade, and real UI proof before merge.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep the issue open only for a plugin/API design if maintainers want math rendering outside the core Control UI bundle.

options.title: Decline first-party math rendering
options.body: Close this issue and related candidate PRs as not planned with the product rationale.

recommendation.title: Review one candidate core implementation
recommendation.body: Pick one open KaTeX/MathJax PR as the landing path and require dependency, sanitizer, config, upgrade, and real UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline and original Control UI markdown history make steipete the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
